name: Ichibun no Ni Koigokoro
source:
Aoi doesn’t go to school; instead he works hard every day on part-time jobs to care for his two imoutos, Hina and Runa. While he does have some regrets about not attending school, he is satisfied and motivated by the sight of his imoutos’ smiles.

One winter day, Aoi was working harder than usual in order to celebrate his imoutos’ birthday, which was fast approaching. Then he reunited with his former kouhai Minori and met his shy neighbour Koyuki. These encounters brought about changes in Aoi’s relationship with his imoutos.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
青不上学，而是每天辛苦打工，照顾两个妹妹阳凪和月凪。虽然他有时会后悔没能上学，但看到妹妹们的笑容，他便感到满足并充满动力。

某个冬日，为庆祝妹妹们即将到来的生日，青比平时更加努力工作。随后，他与以前的学妹实乃里重逢，又遇见了害羞的邻居小雪。这些邂逅改变了青与妹妹们之间的关系。

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
